mapper.select: SELECT PRODUCT_ID, PRODUCT_NAME, BASE_RATE, MAX_RATE, MIN_AMOUNT, MAX_AMOUNT, PERIOD, AUTO_TRANSFER_YN, STATUS, CREATED_AT FROM SAVINGS_PRODUCT WHERE STATUS = 'ON_SALE'
SELECT PRODUCT_ID, PRODUCT_NAME, BASE_RATE, MAX_RATE, MIN_AMOUNT, MAX_AMOUNT, PERIOD, AUTO_TRANSFER_YN, STATUS, CREATED_AT FROM SAVINGS_PRODUCT WHERE PRODUCT_ID = #{productId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO SAVINGS_PRODUCT (PRODUCT_ID, PRODUCT_NAME, BASE_RATE, MAX_RATE, MIN_AMOUNT, MAX_AMOUNT, PERIOD, AUTO_TRANSFER_YN, STATUS, CREATED_AT) VALUES (#{productId}, #{productName}, #{baseRate}, #{maxRate}, #{minAmount}, #{maxAmount}, #{period}, #{autoTransferYn}, #{status}, #{createdAt})
